6pub(super) fn open(path: &Path, preview: bool) -> Result<Connection> {
7    let flags = if preview {
8        OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY
9    } else {
10        OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_READ_WRITE
11    };
12    let connection = Connection::open_with_flags(
13        path,
14        flags | OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_NO_MUTEX | OpenFlags::SQLITE_OPEN_NOFOLLOW,
15    )?;
16    connection.busy_timeout(Duration::from_millis(100))?;
17    if !preview {
18        connection.execute_batch("PRAGMA locking_mode=EXCLUSIVE")?;
19    }
20    connection
21        .execute_batch("PRAGMA cache_size=-8192; PRAGMA mmap_size=0; PRAGMA temp_store=FILE;")?;
22    Ok(connection)
23}

25pub(super) fn pin_database(directory: &cap_std::fs::Dir, path: &Path) -> Result<same_file::Handle> {
26    #[cfg(unix)]
27    let file = {
28        let _ = path;
29        directory.open(DATABASE_NAME)?.into_std()
30    };
31    #[cfg(windows)]
32    let file = {
33        use std::os::windows::fs::OpenOptionsExt;
34        let _ = directory;
35        // Deny delete/rename while SQLite opens this exact file. Reparse points
36        // are opened themselves, then rejected by the identity/type checks.
37        const FILE_SHARE_READ_WRITE: u32 = 0x1 | 0x2;
38        const FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT: u32 = 0x00200000;
39        fs::OpenOptions::new()
40            .read(true)
41            .share_mode(FILE_SHARE_READ_WRITE)
42            .custom_flags(FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
43            .open(path)?
44    };
45    Ok(same_file::Handle::from_file(file)?)
46}

48pub(super) fn admit_database(
49    directory: &cap_std::fs::Dir,
50    path: &Path,
51) -> Result<std::result::Result<same_file::Handle, CacheCompactOutcome>> {
52    #[cfg(unix)]
53    {
54        use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
55        let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
56        let identity = (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino());
57        if open_file_identities()?
58            .values()
59            .any(|value| *value == identity)
60        {
61            // Even a read-only open/close can release an existing SQLite
62            // connection's process-wide POSIX locks for this inode.
63            return Ok(Err(CacheCompactOutcome::SkippedActive {
64                detail: "cache database is already open in this process".into(),
65            }));
66        }
67    }
68    let database = pin_database(directory, path)?;
69    if !has_wal_header(&database)? {
70        return Ok(Err(CacheCompactOutcome::SkippedUnsafe {
71            detail:
72                "compaction requires an existing WAL database; rollback journals are not maintained"
73                    .into(),
74        }));
75    }
76    Ok(Ok(database))
77}

79pub(super) fn has_wal_header(database: &same_file::Handle) -> Result<bool> {
80    use std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom};
81    let mut file = database.as_file();
82    file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0))?;
83    let mut header = [0; 20];
84    match file.read_exact(&mut header) {
85        Ok(()) => Ok(&header[..16] == b"SQLite format 3\0" && header[18..20] == [2, 2]),
86        Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::UnexpectedEof => Ok(false),
87        Err(error) => Err(error.into()),
88    }
89}

99pub(super) fn open_pinned_with(
100    expected: &same_file::Handle,
101    path: &Path,
102    preview: bool,
103    opener: impl FnOnce(&Path, bool) -> Result<Connection>,
104) -> Result<Option<Connection>> {
105    if !database_matches(expected, path)? {
106        return Ok(None);
107    }
108    #[cfg(unix)]
109    let before = if preview {
110        None
111    } else {
112        Some(open_file_identities()?)
113    };
114    #[cfg(unix)]
115    if let Some(before) = &before {
116        let mut allowed = sqlite_file_identities(expected, path)?;
117        let lease = coordination_sidecar_path(path, LEASE_LOCK_SUFFIX);
118        match fs::symlink_metadata(lease) {
119            Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_file() && metadata.len() == 0 => {
120                use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
121                allowed.insert((metadata.dev(), metadata.ino()));
122            }
123            Ok(_) => return Ok(None),
124            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
125            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
126        }
127        if before
128            .iter()
129            .any(|(number, identity)| *number > 2 && !allowed.contains(identity))
130        {
131            // SQLite can reuse a deferred descriptor. Unknown pre-existing
132            // regular files make a before/after proof ambiguous too.
133            return Ok(None);
134        }
135    }
136    let connection = opener(path, preview)?;
137    #[cfg(unix)]
138    if let Some(before) = before
139        && !sqlite_opened_expected_file(expected, path, &before)?
140    {
141        return Ok(None);
142    }
143    if !database_matches(expected, path)? {
144        return Ok(None);
145    }
146    Ok(Some(connection))
147}

150type FileIdentity = (u64, u64);
151
152#[cfg(unix)]
153pub(super) fn open_file_identities() -> Result<BTreeMap<u32, FileIdentity>> {
154    use nix::sys::stat::{SFlag, fstat};
155    let root = if Path::new("/proc/self/fd").is_dir() {
156        Path::new("/proc/self/fd")
157    } else {
158        Path::new("/dev/fd")
159    };
160    let mut files = BTreeMap::new();
161    for (count, entry) in fs::read_dir(root)?.enumerate() {
162        if count >= 1024 {
163            return Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(
164                "too many open descriptors to verify SQLite's database identity".into(),
165            ));
166        }
167        let entry = entry?;
168        let Some(number) = entry
169            .file_name()
170            .to_str()
171            .and_then(|v| v.parse::<u32>().ok())
172        else {
173            continue;
174        };
175        let metadata = match fstat(number as std::os::fd::RawFd) {
176            Ok(metadata) => metadata,
177            Err(nix::errno::Errno::EBADF) => continue,
178            Err(error) => return Err(std::io::Error::from_raw_os_error(error as i32).into()),
179        };
180        if SFlag::from_bits_truncate(metadata.st_mode) & SFlag::S_IFMT == SFlag::S_IFREG {
181            #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
182            let device = metadata.st_dev as u64;
183            #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
184            let device = metadata.st_dev;
185            files.insert(number, (device, metadata.st_ino));
186        }
187    }
188    Ok(files)
189}

191#[cfg(unix)]
192fn sqlite_opened_expected_file(
193    expected: &same_file::Handle,
194    path: &Path,
195    before: &BTreeMap<u32, FileIdentity>,
196) -> Result<bool> {
197    use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
198    let metadata = expected.as_file().metadata()?;
199    let main = (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino());
200    let allowed = sqlite_file_identities(expected, path)?;
201    let mut found_main = false;
202    for (descriptor, identity) in open_file_identities()? {
203        if before.get(&descriptor) == Some(&identity) {
204            continue;
205        }
206        if !allowed.contains(&identity) {
207            // Concurrent unrelated regular-file opens also fail closed; no
208            // inference from mutable path names can authorize an unknown FD.
209            return Ok(false);
210        }
211        found_main |= identity == main;
212    }
213    Ok(found_main)
214}

216#[cfg(unix)]
217fn sqlite_file_identities(
218    expected: &same_file::Handle,
219    path: &Path,
220) -> Result<BTreeSet<FileIdentity>> {
221    use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
222    let metadata = expected.as_file().metadata()?;
223    let main = (metadata.dev(), metadata.ino());
224    let mut allowed = BTreeSet::from([main]);
225    for suffix in ["-wal", "-shm"] {
226        let sidecar = PathBuf::from(format!("{}{suffix}", path.display()));
227        match fs::symlink_metadata(sidecar) {
228            Ok(metadata) if metadata.is_file() && metadata.nlink() == 1 => {
229                allowed.insert((metadata.dev(), metadata.ino()));
230            }
231            Ok(_) => {
232                return Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(
233                    "unsafe SQLite sidecar identity".into(),
234                ));
235            }
236            Err(error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
237            Err(error) => return Err(error.into()),
238        }
239    }
240    Ok(allowed)
241}

255    connection: &Connection,
256    directory: &same_file::Handle,
257    path: &Path,
258) -> Result<bool> {

260        .path()
261        .and_then(|p| fs::canonicalize(p).ok())

274pub(super) fn database_matches(expected: &same_file::Handle, path: &Path) -> Result<bool> {
275    // Never open and close another Unix handle for this inode: closing it
276    // would release this process's POSIX locks, including SQLite's locks.
277    let current = fs::symlink_metadata(path)?;
278    if file_link_count(expected.as_file())? != 1 || !current.file_type().is_file() {
279        return Ok(false);
280    }
281    #[cfg(unix)]
282    {
283        use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
284        let held = expected.as_file().metadata()?;
285        Ok(current.nlink() == 1 && (held.dev(), held.ino()) == (current.dev(), current.ino()))
286    }
287    #[cfg(windows)]
288    {
289        let current = same_file::Handle::from_path(path)?;
290        Ok(expected == &current && file_link_count(current.as_file())? == 1)
291    }
292}

294fn file_link_count(file: &fs::File) -> std::io::Result<u64> {
295    #[cfg(unix)]
296    {
297        use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
298        Ok(file.metadata()?.nlink())
299    }
300    #[cfg(windows)]
301    {
302        Ok(u64::from(
303            winapi_util::file::information(file)?.number_of_links(),
304        ))
305    }

308pub(super) fn linked_artifact(directory: &Path) -> Result<Option<String>> {
309    for entry in fs::read_dir(directory)? {
310        let entry = entry?;
311        #[cfg(unix)]
312        let links = {
313            use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
314            fs::symlink_metadata(entry.path())?.nlink()
315        };
316        #[cfg(windows)]
317        let links =
318            winapi_util::file::information(&fs::File::open(entry.path())?)?.number_of_links();
319        if links != 1 {
320            return Ok(Some(format!(
321                "cache artifact has multiple filesystem links: {}",
322                entry.file_name().to_string_lossy()
323            )));
324        }
325    }
326    Ok(None)
327}

329pub(super) fn page_space(connection: &Connection) -> Result<(u64, u64)> {
330    connection.execute_batch("BEGIN")?;
331    let result = (|| {
332        let page = unsigned_pragma(connection, "page_size")?;
333        let count = unsigned_pragma(connection, "page_count")?;
334        let free = unsigned_pragma(connection, "freelist_count")?;
335        let bytes = page
336            .checked_mul(count)
337            .ok_or_else(|| Error::InvalidConfiguration("database page size overflow".into()))?;
338        let reusable = page
339            .checked_mul(free)
340            .filter(|v| *v <= bytes)
341            .ok_or_else(|| Error::InvalidConfiguration("invalid database freelist size".into()))?;
342        Ok((bytes, reusable))
343    })();
344    connection.execute_batch("ROLLBACK")?;
345    result
346}

348/// Match the bundled VFS selection before testing writability; never substitute
349/// another Windows volume when its first configured candidate is unusable.
350fn temporary_directory(connection: &Connection) -> Result<PathBuf> {
351    let configured: Option<String> = connection
352        .query_row("PRAGMA temp_store_directory", [], |row| row.get(0))
353        .optional()?;
354    #[cfg(unix)]
355    {
356        let mut candidates = Vec::new();
357        if let Some(directory) = configured.filter(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
358            candidates.push(PathBuf::from(directory));
359        }
360        candidates.extend(
361            ["SQLITE_TMPDIR", "TMPDIR"]
362                .into_iter()
363                .filter_map(std::env::var_os)
364                .map(PathBuf::from),
365        );
366        candidates.extend(["/var/tmp", "/usr/tmp", "/tmp", "."].map(PathBuf::from));
367        for directory in candidates {
368            if directory.is_dir() && tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in(&directory).is_ok() {
369                return Ok(fs::canonicalize(directory)?);
370            }
371        }
372        Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(
373            "cannot determine a writable SQLite temporary directory".into(),
374        ))
375    }
376    #[cfg(windows)]
377    {
378        let directory = windows_temporary_candidate(configured, |name| std::env::var_os(name))?;
379        writable_temporary_directory(&directory)
380    }
381}

383#[cfg(any(windows, test))]
384pub(super) fn windows_temporary_candidate(
385    configured: Option<String>,
386    lookup: impl Fn(&str) -> Option<std::ffi::OsString>,
387) -> Result<PathBuf> {
388    if let Some(directory) = configured.filter(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
389        return Ok(PathBuf::from(directory));
390    }
391    // GetTempPathW selects the first nonempty value without existence/access
392    // checks. SQLite uses that API, not GetTempPath2W (Rust's temp_dir fallback).
393    for name in ["TMP", "TEMP", "USERPROFILE"] {
394        if let Some(value) = lookup(name).filter(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
395            return Ok(PathBuf::from(value));
396        }
397    }
398    // Without a known environment candidate, fail closed instead of guessing
399    // Windows' system directory or changing SQLite/process global settings.
400    Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(
401        "cannot identify SQLite's Windows temporary directory".into(),
402    ))
403}

406pub(super) fn writable_temporary_directory(directory: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> {

408    Ok(fs::canonicalize(directory)?)

421pub(super) fn space_shortage_with(
422    connection: &Connection,
423    directory: &Path,
424    bytes: u64,
425    available: impl Fn(&Path) -> std::io::Result<u64>,
426) -> Result<Option<String>> {

428    let shared = same_volume(directory, &temporary).unwrap_or(true);
429    Ok(space_shortage_from(
430        &temporary,
431        bytes,
432        available(directory)?,
433        available(&temporary)?,
434        shared,
435    ))
436}

438pub(super) fn same_volume(left: &Path, right: &Path) -> std::io::Result<bool> {
439    #[cfg(unix)]
440    {
441        use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
442        Ok(fs::metadata(left)?.dev() == fs::metadata(right)?.dev())
443    }
444    #[cfg(windows)]
445    {
446        let left = winapi_util::Handle::from_path_any(left)?;
447        let right = winapi_util::Handle::from_path_any(right)?;
448        Ok(
449            winapi_util::file::information(left.as_file())?.volume_serial_number()
450                == winapi_util::file::information(right.as_file())?.volume_serial_number(),
451        )
452    }
453}

455pub(super) fn space_shortage_from(
456    temporary: &Path,
457    bytes: u64,
458    database_available: u64,
459    temporary_available: u64,
460    shared: bool,
461) -> Option<String> {
462    let margin = 32 * 1024 * 1024;
463    let mut database_required = bytes.saturating_mul(2).saturating_add(margin);
464    let mut temporary_required = bytes.saturating_add(margin);
465    if shared {
466        let combined = database_required.saturating_add(temporary_required);
467        database_required = combined;
468        temporary_required = combined;
469    }
470    if database_available < database_required || temporary_available < temporary_required {
471        return Some(format!(
472            "database volume needs {database_required} free bytes (available {database_available}); SQLite temporary directory {} needs {temporary_required} (available {temporary_available}); shared or unidentified volume: {shared}",
473            temporary.display()
474        ));
475    }
476    None
477}

479fn unsigned_pragma(connection: &Connection, name: &str) -> Result<u64> {
480    let value: i64 = connection.pragma_query_value(None, name, |row| row.get(0))?;
481    u64::try_from(value).map_err(|_| Error::InvalidConfiguration(format!("negative SQLite {name}")))
482}

484type Fingerprint = (Vec<Value>, i64, Vec<(String, String, Option<String>)>);
485pub(super) const COMPACT_META_SQL: &str = "SELECT * FROM meta WHERE id=1";
486
487fn fingerprint(connection: &Connection) -> Result<Fingerprint> {
488    let mut meta = connection.prepare(COMPACT_META_SQL)?;
489    if meta.column_count() > 32 {
490        return Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(
491            "unsupported cache metadata width".into(),
492        ));
493    }
494    let columns = meta.column_count();
495    let values = meta.query_row([], |row| {
496        (0..columns).map(|i| {
497            let value = row.get_ref(i)?;
498            if matches!(value, rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Text(v) | rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Blob(v) if v.len() > 16384) {
499                return Err(rusqlite::Error::FromSqlConversionFailure(
500                    i,
501                    value.data_type(),
502                    std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "cache fingerprint value exceeds 16 KiB").into(),
503                ));
504            }
505            row.get(i)
506        }).collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<Value>, _>>()
507    })?;
508    let version = connection.pragma_query_value(None, "user_version", |row| row.get(0))?;
509    let schema = connection
510        .prepare("SELECT type,name,sql FROM sqlite_schema ORDER BY type,name LIMIT 257")?
511        .query_map([], |row| {
512            for column in 0..3 {
513                let value = row.get_ref(column)?;
514                if matches!(value, rusqlite::types::ValueRef::Text(text) if text.len() > 16384) {
515                    return Err(rusqlite::Error::FromSqlConversionFailure(
516                        column,
517                        value.data_type(),
518                        std::io::Error::new(
519                            std::io::ErrorKind::InvalidData,
520                            "cache fingerprint value exceeds 16 KiB",
521                        )
522                        .into(),
523                    ));
524                }
525            }
526            Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?, row.get(2)?))
527        })?
528        .collect::<std::result::Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
529    if schema.len() > 256 {
530        return Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(
531            "unsupported cache schema size".into(),
532        ));
533    }
534    Ok((values, version, schema))
535}

537fn quick_check(connection: &Connection) -> Result<()> {
538    let check: String = connection.query_row("PRAGMA quick_check(1)", [], |row| row.get(0))?;
539    if check != "ok" {
540        return Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(format!(
541            "SQLite quick_check failed: {check}"
542        )));
543    }
544    Ok(())
545}

547fn checkpoint(connection: &Connection) -> Result<()> {
548    let (busy, _, _): (i64, i64, i64) =
549        connection.query_row("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)", [], |row| {
550            Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?, row.get(2)?))
551        })?;
552    if busy != 0 {
553        return Err(Error::InvalidConfiguration(
554            "checkpoint blocked by a connection outside the cache lease protocol".into(),
555        ));
556    }
557    Ok(())
558}

560pub(super) fn vacuum(connection: &Connection, seconds: u64, committed: &mut bool) -> Result<()> {
561    vacuum_with_budget(connection, Duration::from_secs(seconds), 10000, committed)
562}
563
564pub(super) fn vacuum_with_budget(
565    connection: &Connection,
566    budget: Duration,
567    instructions: i32,
568    committed: &mut bool,
569) -> Result<()> {
570    let before = fingerprint(connection)?;
571    let started = Instant::now();
572    connection.progress_handler(
573        instructions,
574        Some(move || {
575            // Cooperative pacing; callers needing hard CPU limits use OS quotas.
576            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(1));
577            started.elapsed() >= budget
578        }),
579    )?;
580    let operation = (|| {
581        quick_check(connection)?;
582        checkpoint(connection)?;
583        connection.execute_batch("VACUUM")?;
584        *committed = true;
585        if fingerprint(connection)? != before {
586            return Err(Error::OperationFailure(
587                "compaction changed persisted metadata or schema".into(),
588            ));
589        }
590        quick_check(connection)?;
591        checkpoint(connection)?;
592        Ok(())
593    })();
594    connection.progress_handler(0, None::<fn() -> bool>)?;
595    operation
596}
